text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond, the young lady of the 
Satono Group. Her debut in the Twinkle 
Series had been decided.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal is to fulfill the long-cherished 
dream of the Satono clan: to produce "a 
renowned Umamusume capable of winning a 
GⅠ" by becoming that very champion 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bearing expectations and attention from 
both within and outside her family, she 
feels no pressure, declaring that 
fulfilling this long-cherished wish is her 
own personal dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she had one more dream: to run in the 
Twinkle Series alongside her childhood 
friend, Kitasan Black, who had debuted 
before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering dreams and the expectations of 
countless people, Satono Diamond's 
challenge had begun!
